fusions.name: Headsman's Downstroke
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. An overhead chop that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds, then carries you on 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Felling Circle
fusions.desc: Swings the edge through a full turn that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Keen Updraught
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage rises by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sharpened Gust
fusions.desc: Conjures a hatchet of hardened air. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
